svg.title: odoo-migrate-to-20: every module arrives on Odoo 20
svg.desc: A timetable-style banner. Headline: Every module arrives on Odoo 20. A departures board lists Odoo 14.0 to 19.0 modules travelling to Odoo 20.0; two real runs are marked arrived: a 16.0 renamed fork rebased with 12 of 12 tests passing, and an 18.0 website and Owl module taken from 104 findings to 0 that installs.
